time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t*24); t=0 is frame 0
units: pixels, seconds; image y grows downward

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; the background rows and the wall/floor line are identical in frames 0 and 49 outside the mug)
camera.view: front view, roughly horizontal, looking at a plain beige backdrop; vertical falling plane faces the camera
camera.perspective_note: The mug's apparent height changes with its image row (top/bottom ellipses are visible far from the image centre, hidden near y~950); its width stays constant (body 81-82 px, total with handle 112 px), so it stays at one depth. Use the WIDTH for any 2D scale.

objects.name: mug
objects.description: single beige/cream ceramic mug, handle on its right (+x) side; the only object in the scene
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = mask centroid (includes handle); body_cx = centre of the cylinder without the handle; bbox_cx,bbox_cy = bbox centre. For vertical motion all agree to <1 px in differences; body_cx ~ 568.5, bbox_cx 583.5, centroid ~575

extents_px.note: true side-view cylinder height (no rim/bottom ellipse) is best approximated by the minimum ~89 px at frames 13-14 (mug near the image centre row y~836-956)

objects.motion: vertical free fall straight down (x constant to <1.5 px), hits the floor, small rebound/tilt, then rests

positions_px.rest_bbox_note: x0=519 at rest includes a little contact shadow on the left; body x 529-609

objects.name: floor
objects.description: plain beige floor plane, lower part of the image below the boundary row ~1535 (slightly brighter than the wall)

objects.name: backdrop_wall
objects.description: plain beige wall with a soft radial light spot centred about (x~540, y~600-650)

events.note: centroid step frame0->1 is 5.0 px, then 13.8, 22.6, 31.8, 40.6 ... (constant increments ~8.8-9 px/frame^2): starts from (near) rest at frame 0
contact happens between frames 18 and 19; at frame 19 the bottom is already at y=1679 (rest 1676)
bbox top rises to 1559-1565 while the bottom stays ~1677: the mug rocks/hops a few px; centroid y 1621.5, 1618.7, 1620.8
from frame 24 on the position is constant within 0.5 px
